assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The site boundary and three key-area polygons are maintainer-registered provisional boundaries derived from announced text extents, used only for generation, display, and discussion.
assumptions.impact: All spatial conclusions are concept advice; after official redlines are released, layers and area metrics must be recomputed under the same generation rules.

assumptions.statement: FAR, building height, density, green ratio, and setback controls are missing official values and are recorded as unknown in metrics.json; building footprints are a concept massing grid, not approved scale.
assumptions.impact: Development-intensity statements in the narrative are magnitude discussion only, pending regulatory-plan conditions.

assumptions.statement: Railway heritage protection ranges, cultural-relic statuses, and property rights along the Jing-Zhang corridor are not yet published; the heritage protection concept corridor is drawn from public narrative only.
assumptions.impact: Landmark siting and reuse suggestions require heritage and ownership clearance before any implementation.

assumptions.statement: The six global case studies are background research distilled from public references; their figures are not formal evidence and no affiliation with the referenced organizations is implied.
assumptions.impact: Case lessons inform mechanism design only and carry no transfer commitment.
